## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear, concise description of what the problem is, e.g. "I always wish I
could..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you'd like to see happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Fits the project's scope?

Marginalia is intentionally a single, dependency-free `index.html` file with
a strict local-only-by-default privacy model (notes never leave the
visitor's browser unless they're on Claude's Artifact platform). Please note
whether your idea:

- [ ] Keeps everything in `index.html` (no build step, no new dependencies)
- [ ] Preserves the local-only-by-default storage model
- [ ] Something else — explain below

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.
